ratios.quote: Per Credit Agreement Actual Leverage ratio 5.00 (Max) 3.67

parsed.notes: The 3.5x-4.0x figure is a company leverage target, not a covenant, so it is left out. The 0.20% unused commitment fee is also not a covenant. The new $2.5 billion bank credit agreement, due November 2030 and comprising the Bank Credit Facility and the Term Loan, contains a maximum leverage ratio covenant. The excerpt does not say whether the leverage ratio is gross or net; it is classified here as total leverage.
